paragraphs.text: Starfish is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of starfish .

Starfish are invertebrate marine animals with radially arranged bodies, usually in the form of a star, with five or more rays or arms radiating from a central disk. They have a body wall stiffened by calcareous pieces that may protrude as spines. They are the favorite prey of the Stinging Lionfish .
For a long time, the creature type had been used only once, for the card Spiny Starfish (and the tokens it produces) from Alliances . Like its natural counterpart, it can regenerate .
Much later, Journey into Nyx added the Sigiled Starfish . Modern Horizons 2 introduced the first non-blue Starfish in Sinister Starfish .
Foundations Jumpstart introduced the first starfish-folk with Plagon, Lord of the Beach .
Starfish appear aligned with blue or black mana
The Spiny Starfish was seen on Dominaria, which, as its name suggests, is a starfish covered in small spines. They were originally found near Terisiare .

Theros is home to a type of starfish known as the Sigiled Starfish . Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind on them, where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn’t care to read them. They appear as blue starfish with glowing text on them.
It is also home to the Sinister Starfish , which is a black colored starfish with several eyes and small mouths on its body.
Theros is also home to lionfish that are known to prey on starfish.
Sentient starfish like Plagon inhabit an unknown plane.
Avatar: The Last Airbender features Purple Pentapuses which are a hybrid species of Octopus Starfish. They look like small purple octopuses with five tentacles like a starfish.
